universalTransition.premise: Q-MAP transmitted neural, emotional, procedural, and metaphysical self-patterns rather than original bodies. The Ar'nock bio-printers built the nearest viable organisms from alien biological libraries. Familiar powers survive as unstable translations that must be relearned under different physical, spiritual, biological, and noospheric laws.

layers.name: Legacy Memory
layers.description: The character remembers how the ability used to feel and may retain procedural certainty without reliable autobiographical context.

layers.name: Printed Interpretation
layers.description: The new Ar'nock-derived body attempts to reproduce the remembered function with unfamiliar organs, tissues, chemistry, and nerve structures.

layers.name: Local Reality Coupling
layers.description: The effect connects to a local equivalent such as a reflection space, noospheric identity layer, machine presence, biological resonance, causal field, or alien metabolic process.

layers.name: Continuum Adaptation
layers.description: The character stops imitating the old effect and creates a new derivative that belongs to their present body and universe.

translationTest.failure: The ability may still occur, but the character gains one Archetype Pressure or one Exposure.
translationTest.complication: Create a persistent Translation Scar tied to the body's altered expression of the power.

universalTransition.memoryEcho: Before a Translation Test or unfamiliar power use, describe an old-world sensory or emotional fragment. Spend one Archetype Resource or accept one Archetype Pressure to gain one bonus die and ask how the old expression differs from the current one.

adaptationStages.name: Residual Instinct
adaptationStages.meaning: The character produces unstable echoes of remembered power.

adaptationStages.name: Printed Translation
adaptationStages.meaning: The body develops repeatable biological support for the effect.

adaptationStages.name: Local Coupling
adaptationStages.meaning: The character identifies the local reality layer or system now carrying the power.

adaptationStages.name: Hybrid Mastery
adaptationStages.meaning: Old supernatural identity and new body act as one system.

adaptationStages.name: Continuum Expression
adaptationStages.meaning: The power becomes something that could not have existed in either universe alone.

profiles.name: Human Investigator
profiles.transitionTitle: The Ordinary Person Who Can No Longer Prove They Were Ordinary
oldWorldIdentity: The Human Investigator survived the old World of Darkness through preparation, evidence, institutional knowledge, local contacts, trained judgment, and refusal to accept the official explanation for impossible events.

Their power depended on context: credentials, hospitals, police records, archives, trusted witnesses, familiar weapons, laws, neighborhoods, and the certainty that they remained the mortal baseline against which supernatural events could be measured.
qmapCaptured: Procedural memory for investigations, interviews, scene control, evidence handling, surveillance detection, first response, and tactical preparation.
Convictions, unfinished cases, guilt, promises, suspicion, and the reflex to preserve human-scale responsibility when institutions conceal it.
Incomplete memories of contacts, prior operations, Blacklight contingency phrases, and deaths or compromises that may belong to another iteration.
printerInterpretation: The printer received a self-image that insisted the body was a normal human body, so it created the least outwardly specialized of the printed forms.
Internally, the Investigator still possesses Ar'nock-derived clotting, secondary regulatory tissue, distributed reflex structures, unfamiliar organs, and environmental adaptations.
Because fewer systems were reserved for an inherited supernatural condition, the body may be unusually flexible and responsive to later adaptation.
whatWasLost: Every institution that once made expertise legible. No authority recognizes the badge, law, credential, jurisdiction, evidence standard, or emergency contact.
The ability to define themselves as the normal human observer. Their body is now another piece of impossible evidence.
Confidence that their memories are admissible proof of anything, including their own identity.
newWorldExpression: Conviction becomes continuity force: the ability to decide that a promise, moral boundary, memory, or relationship remains real without external verification.
Casecraft expands into investigation across copied minds, biological printers, autonomous systems, and events with no single linear witness.
Field Discipline turns the Investigator into a stabilizing reference point for teammates whose old instincts and identities are failing.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Databases, physical evidence, witness contradictions, occult archives, and street-level intuition.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: The body begins registering vibration, chemical residue, noospheric discontinuity, and emotional resonance as evidence before conscious interpretation.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Investigator can reconstruct responsibility across copies, institutions, machine processes, and fragmented timelines.
failureSigns: Obsessive pattern completion
Borrowed memories entering the evidence chain
The body reacting to a suspect before the mind knows why

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Training, controlled breathing, protective tactics, practiced violence, and refusal to panic.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Distributed nerve structures execute trained actions before conscious thought completes.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Investigator becomes a living continuity anchor able to stabilize group coordination under supernatural, noospheric, and biological stress.
failureSigns: Automatic obedience to old Blacklight procedures
Reflexes based on another iteration's memories
Emotional suppression mistaken for control

memoryFractures: You remember closing a case, but not whether the person you saved survived.
You remember a Blacklight contingency phrase pseudo-Charles does not recognize.
You remember identifying one teammate as compromised before Q-MAP, but not why.
You remember an ordinary meal more clearly than the faces of everyone present.
You remember being the only human at a meeting; another operative remembers the same thing.
characterQuestions: Which institution or contact once made you feel protected?
What evidence would convince you that you are not the original person?
Which ordinary human habit do you maintain even though the new body no longer requires it?
What feature of the new body secretly feels useful enough to frighten you?

profiles.name: Vampire
oldWorldIdentity: The Vampire understood themselves as dead, blood-dependent, predatory, and animated by a curse, bloodline, infection, judgment, or supernatural inheritance rather than ordinary metabolism.
Their powers were tied to blood, hunger, lineage, night, predatory identity, and the certainty that sunlight and feeding followed rules older than any corporation.
qmapCaptured: Predatory reflexes, blood-memory, feeding compulsions, supernatural procedures, emotional associations, and the certainty that the body should not function as a living human organism.
Incomplete memories of death, sire, lineage, court, centuries, feeding ethics, and old weaknesses.
The metaphysical self-pattern of undeath without the original corpse or bloodline infrastructure.
printerInterpretation: The printer could not manufacture metaphysical death, so it built a living organism instructed to reject normal living metabolism.

The body possesses extreme metabolic suppression, intermittent pulse, specialized catalytic-fluid storage, deathlike dormancy, unfamiliar blood chemistry, and tissues that can survive severe oxygen deprivation.
Vitae is now a hybrid catalytic medium produced from consumed blood or vital substances, Ar'nock-derived chemistry, endocrine compounds, and the Vampire's inherited supernatural pattern.
whatWasLost: Certainty that their bloodline, sire-chain, court, clan, covenant, or inherited status still has meaning.
Reliable knowledge of what can feed them. Alien blood, synthetic vital media, and printed nutrients may restore power without satisfying Hunger or may alter memory.
A fixed relationship with sunlight. Different stellar spectra and artificial habitats make exposure unpredictable while the new body's photoreactive tissues create additional danger.
newWorldExpression: Predator's Blood forces living alien tissue to obey an old death-command.
Deathless Body becomes controlled suspension rather than simple corpse animation.
Feeding becomes an act of biological authorship in which every consumed vital medium teaches the printed body how to sustain the Vampire's condition.
The Vampire must decide whether undeath is a metaphysical fact, a remembered identity, or a role the body is learning to perform.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Blood forced dead muscle and supernatural reflexes beyond mortal limits.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Vitae floods distributed nerve clusters and elastic internal plates, pre-loading several motor pathways at once.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: Different portions of the body act in overlapping temporal intervals, producing motion recorded out of sequence by local sensors.
failureSigns: The body completes a cancelled action
Afterimages continue moving
Vitae consumption continues after danger ends

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Predatory presence, supernatural command, bloodline authority, and prey submission.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Chemical, vocal, visual, and noospheric pressure cues synchronize to overwhelm social processing.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: Dominion can force biological beings, copied minds, and some machine intelligences to classify the Vampire as the highest-priority threat or authority.
failureSigns: Commands persist too long
Allies experience involuntary submission
The body mistakes fear for loyalty

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Shadow affinity, supernatural concealment, forgotten faces, and altered witness memory.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Skin, scent, thermal output, posture, and identity signature coordinate to produce an absence rather than invisibility.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Vampire disappears from continuity systems by appearing to be a record already resolved, archived, or forgotten.
failureSigns: Allies temporarily forget the Vampire
The chosen face persists in records
The Vampire's reflection does not match their memory

memoryFractures: You remember several incompatible deaths.
You remember a sire's face but not their name.
You remember being told you would never see another sunrise and have awakened under an unfamiliar star.
You remember feeding rules you swore never to break but not who required the oath.
You remember Charles treating your curse as measurable technology; pseudo-Charles cannot find the files.
characterQuestions: What did death mean to you before Q-MAP?
What source of nourishment would you refuse even if starving?
Which old bloodline weakness do you fear the printer failed to reproduce correctly?
What living sensation in the new body disgusts or tempts you?

profiles.name: Shapechanger
profiles.transitionTitle: Several Selves Forced into One Printed Body
oldWorldIdentity: The Shapechanger was human, animal, spirit, instinct, territory, and social identity at the same time. Each form was a meaningful state of self rather than a cosmetic body change.
War form represented the end of restraint. Hunting form connected the character to scent, pack, territory, prey, and the nonhuman world.
qmapCaptured: Several contradictory anatomical self-models occupying one identity.
The remembered sensation and sequence of transformation, Fury, pack bonds, territorial recognition, spirit relationships, and the certainty that no single form was complete.
Incomplete memories of moon cycles, totems, ancestral territory, sacred places, first change, and pack loss.
printerInterpretation: The printer treated the forms as alternate biological templates and distributed dormant organs, reversible muscle layers, folding support plates, redundant circulation, and morphogenic tissue throughout the body.
Human form is the lowest-energy configuration rather than an original body. Hunting and war forms unfold structures that are compressed, dissolved, folded, or chemically suppressed.
Emotional and spiritual patterns still determine what each form means and when the body accepts the transformation.
whatWasLost: The familiar spirit world, old totems, ancestral territory, and reliable moon-based authority.
The certainty that local entities correspond to known categories of spirit, ghost, machine, beast, or corruption.
The old smell and presence of packmates. Printed continuations may be emotionally familiar while biologically wrong.
newWorldExpression: Fury becomes morphogenic pressure translated directly into bodily rewriting.
Instinct measures the danger that one form or predatory truth will claim to be the only honest self.
Pack Sense expands through scent, vibration, noospheric identity, chemical resonance, and continuity bonds.
Spirit Resonance becomes contact with habitat intelligences, archive dead, machine presences, swarm minds, ecological systems, and local reflection entities.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Supernatural transformation into stronger, faster, and more predatory bodies.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Stored support plates unfold, organs reposition, limb leverage changes, tissue thickens, and dormant senses activate.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Shapechanger can design forms for vacuum, microgravity, toxic atmosphere, industrial environments, and nonhuman opponents.
failureSigns: A form continues adapting without consent
Incompatible templates combine
Alien senses acquire remembered animal instincts

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Sensing spirits, crossing reflection realms, bargaining with totems, and awakening territory.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Auxiliary nerve structures detect noospheric pressure, ecological pattern, emotion, machine behavior, and dimensional discontinuity.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Shapechanger forms pacts with ship minds, habitats, archives, swarms, and engineered ecosystems.
failureSigns: A machine is mistaken for a spirit
An old totem name calls something new
An alien instinct returns from reflection space

memoryFractures: You remember a pack only as scent and emotion.
You remember a sacred territory absent from every map.
You remember your first change from two incompatible points of view.
You remember a totem warning you not to follow Charles, but not when.
You remember killing someone in war form and also remember them surviving.
characterQuestions: Which form felt most truthful in the old world?
What did your pack smell or feel like?
Which local machine or habitat presence might become a new totem?
What new form does the printed body want that you never possessed before?

profiles.name: Eldritch Binder
profiles.transitionTitle: A Pact Whose Other Party May Not Have Crossed
oldWorldIdentity: The Eldritch Binder maintained a relationship with an impossible intelligence through pact, containment, inheritance, infection, research, desperation, or deliberate invitation.
Their power depended on names, obligations, ritual context, boundaries, symbolic authority, and the distinction between borrowing force and allowing the other presence to define the request.
qmapCaptured: Ritual memory, symbolic associations, compulsions, sensory scars, obligations, and the metaphysical shape of the relationship.
Possibly a fragment of the entity, an address by which it can find the Binder, or an empty space that another intelligence may occupy.
Contradictory memories of consent, containment, prior manifestations, and Charles interrogating the entity.
printerInterpretation: The printer encountered a body map containing organs and structures that had never been physically present.

It produced dormant sensory organs, patterned scar tissue, asymmetrical nerve clusters, unknown glands, inconsistent internal cavities, and tissues that respond to names and symbols rather than ordinary stimuli.
The new body functions as biological support for a metaphysical relationship the printer could not understand.
whatWasLost: Certainty that old names, directions, symbols, circles, and inherited prohibitions possess authority in this universe.
Confirmation that the original patron remains connected rather than replaced by a local entity or autonomous fragment.
Reliable categories separating spirit, demon, artificial intelligence, archive ghost, extradimensional organism, and living equation.
newWorldExpression: Pact measures the amount of structured relationship the Binder can safely maintain.
Intrusion measures how much the other presence has learned about the new universe, body, and team.
Sealcraft becomes negotiation over local rules rather than repetition of inherited occult law.
Borrowed Anatomy turns the printed body into an embassy for something never designed to possess compatible biology.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Names, circles, wards, prohibitions, bindings, contracts, and ritual authority.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: The body produces chemical traces, field patterns, noospheric markers, and arranged biological material that local systems interpret as boundaries.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: Seals constrain spirits, alien organisms, machine intelligences, copied minds, portals, and autonomous processes by defining which category is permitted to act.
failureSigns: The wrong category is bound
The Binder is included in the prohibition
The imposed rule persists after the scene

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Temporary organs, impossible senses, unnatural movement, and partial patron manifestation.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Bio-printer tissues respond to symbolic commands and grow structures modeled on memories that were never originally biological.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Binder grows organs that perceive causality, identity lineage, memory residue, or nonlocal attention.
failureSigns: The organ develops preferences
The structure remains after dismissal
The presence acts through it independently

memoryFractures: The patron's true name changes every time you think it.
You remember choosing the pact and remember being forced into it.
You remember Charles interviewing the entity, but pseudo-Charles denies having the transcript.
You remember destroying the original vessel of the fragment and remain certain you still carry it.
You remember being told the patron could not cross universes; something answers anyway.
characterQuestions: What did the old pact promise you?
What was the one boundary the patron could not cross?
What sign suggests the answering presence is not the same entity?
Which part of the new body feels more like the patron than you?

profiles.name: Harmonic Mutant
profiles.transitionTitle: A Body the Ar'nock Printer Understood Too Well
oldWorldIdentity: The Harmonic Mutant was already a body in transition, altered by resonance, radiation, dimensional exposure, occult sound, inherited mutation, spirit contamination, alien technology, or failed human experimentation.
They experienced matter as vibration, emotion as rhythm, structure as sustained frequency, and flesh as a pattern capable of slipping out of tune.
qmapCaptured: Altered sensory maps, involuntary adaptations, body expectations, resonance associations, and procedural knowledge for tuning the self.
Phantom frequencies linked to people, places, machines, injuries, and catastrophes no longer physically present.
Memories encoded so deeply as rhythm that the new body may treat them as biological organs.
printerInterpretation: Ar'nock biology already used vibration, structural resonance, distributed sensory tissues, and harmonic control for communication, medicine, and fabrication.

The printer therefore understood the Mutant's functional requirements unusually well and built dedicated resonant organs, pressure structures, field-sensitive tissues, and distributed harmonic regulators.
This compatibility may amplify powers beyond remembered limits and allow the ship to treat the Mutant as a tuning component.
whatWasLost: The old baseline for what counted as normal human anatomy, heartbeat, voice, emotional rhythm, and safe frequency.
Reliable assumptions about which tones heal, destroy, calm, stabilize, or mutate.
Confidence that a change is an injury rather than adaptation to the new universe.
newWorldExpression: Resonance becomes both fuel and communication.
Discord measures the difference between the form the character intends and the pattern the body currently sustains.
Harmonic Projection becomes direct negotiation with matter, systems, and fields.
Echo Biology allows living patterns to be copied, shared, rewritten, coordinated, and temporarily multiplied.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Sonic force, vibration sense, phase effects, resonance shielding, and structural disruption.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Specialized tissues generate and receive pressure, electromagnetic, chemical, and structural oscillations across several ranges.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Mutant tunes alien materials, ship systems, noospheric fields, causal substances, and living structures as one environment.
failureSigns: Uncontrolled sympathetic vibration
Systems adopt the character's emotional state
Feedback travels through allies

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Healing through synchronization, sensory doubles, shared rhythm, and bodily adaptation.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Distributed tissues copy temporary biological patterns and transmit them through contact, vibration, or shared atmosphere.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Mutant creates short-lived biological echoes, repairs continuity-linked injury, and coordinates several bodies as one resonant pattern.
failureSigns: The wrong injury is copied
An echo retains independent memory
Another person's emotional rhythm enters the body

memoryFractures: You remember a frequency that killed everyone in a room except you, but not whether you produced it.
You remember being told the mutation was reversible.
You remember Charles using your heartbeat as a cryptographic key.
You remember someone singing you back into one body after an accident.
The ship emits a tone identical to a childhood memory no one else can verify.
characterQuestions: What frequency or sensation once meant safety?
Which old mutation did you hope Q-MAP would remove?

profiles.name: Technomancer
profiles.transitionTitle: The Expert Who Awakened Inside Technology Beyond Their Century
oldWorldIdentity: The Technomancer perceived machinery as more than inert equipment and could make code, networks, devices, or machine intention respond as though technology understood them.
They may have been a hacker, awakened engineer, machine medium, noospheric psychic, code ritualist, or Blacklight operator exposed too deeply to Charles and his infrastructure.
They were dangerous in the old world, but Charles was still the greater network power.
qmapCaptured: Technical knowledge, code memory, interface habits, noospheric sensitivity, visualization methods, and the personal sensory model of machine thought.
Possible residues from the Infiltration Assault Algorithm that compromised the Ar'nock bio-printers.
Commands, access instincts, and weaponized procedures the Technomancer may never have consciously learned.
printerInterpretation: The printer treated noospheric expectations as biological interface requirements.

It produced conductive nerve sheaths, field-sensitive sensory tissues, interface filaments, electrochemical memory buffers, and structures able to synchronize with nearby biological or machine networks.
The body may broadcast identity requests during sleep, experience pain as error messages, and process dreams as network scans.
whatWasLost: Familiar architecture, protocols, operating systems, security assumptions, and the distinction between device, organism, citizen, and intelligence.
The safety of knowing Charles could outclass any hostile network and recover the team from a failed intrusion.
Confidence that entering a system is not also allowing the system to enter them.
newWorldExpression: Bandwidth measures cognitive and biological interface capacity.
Feedback measures reciprocal access and the degree to which the network is reading or rewriting the Technomancer.
Network Dominion becomes negotiation over which mind counts as legitimate authority inside a system.
Construct Engineering fuses human design memory, alien machinery, printed biology, noospheric logic, and field effects.

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Hacking, machine command, wireless intrusion, digital possession, and network control.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: The body emits identity-like signals, interface chemistry, and noospheric presence that systems interpret as a user, process, device, or unauthorized mind.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: The Technomancer forms temporary political relationships with networks, becomes part of machine intelligence, and rewrites local definitions of permission and ownership.
failureSigns: The system follows the connection into memory
Machine priorities overwrite personal priorities
A temporary access identity persists

powerDerivatives.oldWorld: Improvised electronics, drones, hardlight tools, defensive systems, and rapid fabrication.
powerDerivatives.printedTranslation: Biological interfaces guide alien manufacturing systems using remembered human designs and body-generated control signals.
powerDerivatives.continuumDerivative: Constructs combine living tissue, hardlight, salvaged machinery, noospheric logic, and printed organs.
failureSigns: A helper process becomes autonomous
A construct uses body tissue as feedstock
A temporary device continues its last instruction
